parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  k.id,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias,
  k.project_name
FROM keywords k
WHERE k.status = 'processed'
{{ $json.body?.keyword_cluster_id ? "  AND k.id = '" + $json.body.keyword_cluster_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "" }}
  AND k.id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT keyword_cluster_id 
    FROM ideas 
    WHERE keyword_cluster_id IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY k.created_at DESC
{{ $json.body?.limit ? "LIMIT " + $json.body.limit : "LIMIT 10" }}

INSERT INTO ideas (
  keyword_cluster_id,
  idea_title,
  categoria,
  status,
  estimated_word_count,
  priority
)
VALUES (
  NULLIF('{{ $json.cluster_id }}','')::uuid,
  '{{ String($json.idea_title).replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
  '{{ $json.categoria }}',
  'pending',
  600,
  {{ $json.priority || 0 }}
)
RETURNING id, idea_title, categoria;
